description: Historical Pipeline Targets and Balances is a dataset listed in Hawaii Department of Transportation open data portal (highways.hidot.hawaii.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Hawaii Department of Transportation. This dataset provides a historical look at the federal pipeline targets vs actuals (year-end balance) outlined by the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA). The federal pipeline is the amount of federal aid money in various highways projects. Each row is a yearly record showing the target and year-end balance for that year. Coverage: Hawaii. The portal files it under the category Pipeline. The table has 3 columns. The portal shows 2024-10-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-highways-hidot-hawaii-gov-portal.
